rationale: terminal-colors.ts parseTerminalColorSchemeReport(data) returns TerminalColorScheme | undefined; Go returns the TerminalColorScheme value with its unknown/zero value for undefined. Test-mapping packages/tui/test/terminal-colors.test.ts records the 'parses color scheme reports' case ported.

utils.ts wrapTextWithAnsi(text, width) is tui/widthx.WrapTextWithAnsi(text, width) []string. Test-mapping packages/tui/test/wrap-ansi.test.ts records all 19 upstream cases ported with exact text/width predicates and a compiling hyperlink-terminator mutation.

terminal-image.ts detectCapabilities(tmuxForwardsHyperlink?) takes an optional probe callback; Go takes the callback as a func() bool and nil for absent. GetCapabilities calls it on the cache miss. Ported upstream detection cases in terminal-image.test.ts.

coding-agent highlightCode(code, lang?) returns string[]; Go tui.HighlightCode(code, lang string) []string (an empty lang is the absent argument), over the highlight.js 10.7.3 port in tui/internal/hljs. Test-mapping packages/coding-agent/test/syntax-highlight.test.ts records all 8 cases ported.

skills.ts loadSkillsFromDir(options) returns LoadSkillsResult; Go takes LoadSkillsFromDirOptions and returns LoadSkillsResult. Test-mapping packages/coding-agent/test/skills.test.ts records all 28 cases ported with the same fixtures, including the 17 directory-loading cases.

components/image.ts setImageTranscoder(transcoder | undefined); Go SetImageTranscoder(ImageTranscoder) with nil for undefined, clearing the shared conversions. Ported transcoding cases in terminal-image.test.ts.
